title: Protocol to generate xenogeneic-free/serum-free human dental pulp stem cells
protocol: Discard the transfer medium from human tooth samples.
Wash the samples with 10 mL of D-PBS three times.
Prepare tooth samples by washing them in 1 mL of Dulbecco’s phosphate buffered saline (D-PBS) on a petri dish.
Hold the tooth sample using forceps.
Pull out dental pulp tissue using an endodontic file or dental probe under a stereoscopic microscope on a 100 mm petri dish.
Drop 100–200 μL of D-PBS onto the sample.
Mince the tissue sample as finely as possible using a scalpel with surgical blade #23.
Immerse the minced pulp tissue sample into 6 mL of tissue digestion medium in a 50 mL conical polypropylene centrifuge tube.
Incubate the medium for 30 min at 37°C in a water bath.
Mix every 10 min with a Vortex mixer to help break up tissue.
Centrifuge at 300 × g at 4°C for 6 min.
Aspirate the supernatant carefully.
Resuspend the cell pellet gently with 1 mL of CGM and add 4 mL of CGM.
Repeat this step again.
Pass the cell suspension through a 70 μm cell strainer.
Centrifuge at 300 × g at 4°C for 6 min and aspirate the supernatant carefully.
Resuspend the cell pellet gently with 1 mL of CGM and store at 4°C.
Mix 10 μL of cell suspension with 90 μL of Turk’s solution in a 1.5 mL polystyrene conical centrifuge tube.
Count number of ANCs in triplicate with a TC20TM automated cell counter using a cell counting slide for TC10TM.
Determine cell number from the mean of the three measurements.
Seed ANCs at 1–2 × 10^6 cells in 10 mL of CGM onto T-75 flask.
Shake the flasks gently on an 8-loop shaker.
Incubate the flasks for 18 hours at 37°C with 5% CO2 in a CO2 incubator.
Wash the flasks gently with 3 mL of D-PBS three times to eliminate unattached cells.
Add 10 mL of CGM and maintain the flasks at 37°C with 5% CO2 in a CO2 incubator.
Replace with 10 mL of CGM 7 days after seeding.
Maintain further for 7 days.
Gently wash the flask twice with 3 mL of D-PBS.
Put 1 mL of cell dissociation reagent, TrypLE select without phenol red, into each flask and incubate for 5 min at 37°C with 5% CO2 in a CO2 incubator.
Add 2 mL of CGM per flask and suspend gently well to remove colony-forming cells from the flask.
Transfer the cell suspension into a 50 mL conical polypropylene centrifuge tube through a 70-μm cell strainer.
Centrifuge at 300 × g at 4°C for 6 min on a centrifuge machine.
Discard the supernatant and resuspend the cell pellet with 1 mL of CGM gently.
Count the number of ANCs as described in step 3.
Seed 1.0–2.5 × 10^5 cells per flask into 10 mL of CGM onto a T75 flask and maintain hDPSCs in 10 mL of CGM at 37°C with 5% CO2 in a CO2 incubator.
Change the culture medium twice a week.
Passage or cryopreserve hDPSCs when they reach 70% confluence.
Dissociate cultured cells as described in step 5.
Resuspend cell pellet in 1 mL of STEM CELL BANKER® cryomedium instead of CGM and store at 4°C.
Count the number of ANCs as described in step 3.
Adjust the concentration to 2.0 × 10^6/mL with additional cryomedium.
Divide 1 mL of the cell suspension per cryogenic vial.
Keep the vials for 4 h at -80°C in a cell freezing container, then store in liquid nitrogen.
Put a cryogenic vial in a cell thawing system, ThawSTAR® CFT2.
Transfer thawed cells into a 15 mL polystyrene conical centrifuge tube with 4 mL of CGM.
Optional: Cell thawing is done using a water bath at 37°C.
Centrifuge at 300 × g at 4°C for 6 min and wash the thawed cells with 5 mL of CGM.
Aspirate the supernatant completely and suspend the cell pellet with 1 mL of CGM gently.
Count the number of cells as described in step 3.
Seed the cells as described in step 6.
Wash adherent cells twice with 1 mL of D-PBS.
Treat the cells with toluidine blue staining solution for 1 day at 20°C.
Wash the dishes several times with Milli-Q water gently and dry at 20°C.
Capture colonies using a light microscope and/or a scanner.
Score the number of cell clusters containing more than 50 cells under an inverted light microscope.
Calculate the colony-forming efficacy.
Dissociate cultured hDPSCs as described previously, wash with HBSS, and resuspend in 1 mL of FCM buffer.
Adjust the concentration of the cell suspension to 1.0 × 10^6 ANCs/mL using additional FCM buffer, resuspend gently, and keep on ice for at least 15 minutes.
Divide the cell suspension into 100 μL aliquots in a 5 mL round bottom polypropylene centrifuge tube and keep on ice.
Incubate with appropriate primary antibodies to CD146, CD105, CD90, CD73, CD45, CD35, CD14, CD11b, and HLA-DR or isotype-matched controls at a concentration of 1.0 μg/mL for 45 minutes on ice.
Centrifuge the samples at 300 × g at 4°C for 6 minutes.
Wash cells twice with 2 mL of FCM buffer.
Add 5 μL of 7-AAD viability staining solution to each sample, tap gently, and incubate for 5 minutes on ice in the dark.
Seed expanded hDPSCs into a 60 mm or 35 mm culture dish at 1.0 × 10^5 or 3 × 10^4 in 5 or 5 mL of CGM, respectively.
Incubate the cells at 37°C with 5% CO2 in a CO2 incubator and change the medium twice a week until the cells reach to 100% confluent condition.
Replace the medium to an equivalent volume of osteogenic or adipogenic inductive medium.
Change odontogenic/osteogenic or adipogenic inductive medium twice a week.
Analyze calcium deposition by Alizarin red S staining 4 weeks after osteogenic induction.
Aspirate the medium and rinse gently the cultures twice with D-PBS.
Dehydrate with 1 mL of 60% isopropanol for 1 min.
Rehydrate in Milli-Q water for 2–3 min.
Stain the cultures with 1% w/v Alizarin red S staining solution for 3–5 minutes at 20°C.
Rinse the cultures with Milli-Q water.
Remove excess Alizarin red S stain dye.
Air dry the cultures well.
Observe the cultures under an inverted light microscopy.
Aspirate the medium from the cultures.
Rinse the cultures twice gently with D-PBS.
Fix the cultures with 4% PFA for 20 minutes at 20°C.
Rinse the cultures with D-PBS.
Hydrate the cultures with 1 mL of 60% isopropanol for 1 minute.
Aspirate the isopropanol solution.
Stain the cultures with Oil Red O staining solution for 10–20 minutes at 20°C.
Rinse the cultures with 1 mL of 60% isopropanol.
Remove excess Oil Red O stain dye.
Store the cultures in Milli-Q water at 4°C.
Observe the cultures under an inverted light microscopy.
Seed expanded hDPSCs into a well of PrimeSurface® 96-well plate at 1.0 × 10^5 cells in 200 μL of CGM.
Incubate the cells at 37°C with 5% CO2 in a CO2 incubator.
Change the medium gently twice a week for 1 week.
Replace the medium with an equivalent volume of chondrogenic inductive medium after seeding.
Change the chondrogenic inductive medium gently twice a week.
Aspirate the medium and rinse cultures twice with D-PBS.
Fix the cultures with 4% PFA for 60 min at 20°C.
Rinse the samples with D-PBS.
Dehydrate samples through an ascending alcohol gradient (70%, 80%, 90%, 100%) in three minutes each.
Clean the samples with xylene in three minutes each.
Immerse the samples in melted paraffin for 8 hours.
Embed the samples in paraffin.
Cut embedded materials into 4-μm sections.
Dewax paraffin sections with xylene in three minutes each.
Rehydrate samples through a descending alcohol gradient (100%, 90%, 80%, 70%) in three minutes each.
Treat the samples with 3% acetic acid solution for 2 min.
Stain the samples with Alcian blue staining solution for 30 min at 20°C.
Wash in Milli-Q water.
Dehydrate through an ascending alcohol gradient: wash in 70% ethanol for 3 min, 80% ethanol for 3 min, 90% ethanol for 3 min, and twice with 100% ethanol for 3 min each.
Clean with xylene (twice, for 3 min each).
Treat with a mounting medium.
Wash the cultured cells with 1 mL of D-PBS twice.
Collect the cultured cells with TRIzol® reagent using a cell scraper.
Extract total RNA according to the manufacturer’s instructions.
Digest the DNA with RQ1 RNase-free DNase according to the manufacturer’s instructions.
Purify the digest sample using a RNeasy Mini Kit following the manufacturer’s instructions.
Store the purified total RNA at -80°C before proceeding to RT-PCR reaction.
Synthesize cDNA by reverse transcription of total RNA using a ReverTraAce® qPCR RT Master Mix according to the manufacturer's instructions.
Amplify cDNA using EagleTaq Master Mix and TaqMan probes for RUNX2.
Amplify cDNA using EagleTaq Master Mix and TaqMan probes for BGLAP.
Amplify cDNA using EagleTaq Master Mix and TaqMan probes for PPARG.
Amplify cDNA using EagleTaq Master Mix and TaqMan probes for LPL.
Amplify cDNA using EagleTaq Master Mix and TaqMan probes for SOX9.
Amplify cDNA using EagleTaq Master Mix and TaqMan probes for COL10A1.
Amplify cDNA using EagleTaq Master Mix and TaqMan probes for 18S rRNA.
